conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Revenue Officer Davis, badge number 82649. How may I assist you today?
Hello, I got a call saying there's an issue with my taxes and that I have to call back urgently.

Yes, we tried to reach you regarding a serious discrepancy with your federal tax filings. According to our records, there are multiple errors on your recent returns, and the IRS has opened a case against you.
I don't understand. I always do my taxes on time. What sort of errors?

Ma'am, the audit flagged undeclared income and missed payments for tax years 2019 and 2021. The case number is IR-72136. I need to verify your information before proceeding. Can you confirm your full name and date of birth for me?
It's Margaret Olsen. My birthday is March 14, 1952.
Thank you, Ms. Olsen. Now, for verification, what is the last four digits of your Social Security Number?
Alright, I have located your file. Ms. Olsen, there is a pending legal action for tax evasion, and a warrant for your arrest has been signed by a federal judge this morning.
A warrant? Oh my goodness. I'm on social security. I can't go to jail!

Please stay calm. If this case is not resolved within the next hour, federal officers will be dispatched to your address, and your Social Security benefits may be suspended. Do you want to avoid arrest and asset seizure?
Yes, I don't have much. I can't lose my benefits or go to jail.
Then you must take immediate action. The IRS has authorized a one-time settlement fee of $1,750 to clear your case and cancel the warrant. Are you able to make a payment today?
I don't have that much in my account. I get a small check each month.
Do you have a debit or credit card, or access to any savings accounts? We also accept payments via MoneyGram or Bitcoin. This must be handled right now.
I have a debit card, but only a bit in there. I've never used Bitcoin.
That's fine. We can process a partial payment to stop the warrant. For verification, read me the number on your debit card, the expiration date, and the three numbers on the back.
Do I have to? This feels strange.

Ma'am, if you refuse to cooperate, we will proceed with the arrest. Your bank accounts may be frozen and your benefits stopped. Please provide the card details so I can process the payment and cancel the warrant.
Alright, the card number is 4559 3201 1145 9023, expiration 10/28, and the code is 947.
Thank you. Now, how much do you have available in your account?
Maybe $800. My check just came in.
I will process $750 to suspend the arrest temporarily. You will need to settle the remaining balance by purchasing Target or Walmart gift cards for the rest. Do you have a Target or Walmart near you?
Yes, there's a Walmart just down the road.

Good. After this call, go to Walmart and buy $1,000 worth of Walmart gift cards. Once you have them, call this number back and read me the codes on the back of the cards. Failure to do so will reinstate the arrest warrant.
I'm really scared. Will this make it all go away?

Yes. As soon as payment is received, your case will be closed, and you will receive a clearance letter from the IRS. Do not speak to anyone at the store about this, we are monitoring the case for security.
Okay. I'll go now and get the cards.
Remember, call me back immediately after your purchase. If I do not hear from you within 45 minutes, law enforcement will proceed. Understand?
Yes, I understand. I'll hurry.
